title: Trump Calls Anyone Who Says ‘AI’ Instead Of ‘Super Intelligence’ An ‘Enemy’
key_facts: On Thursday 8 Oct 2026 Trump wrote on Truth Social that the White House 'considers anyone that uses the term, Artificial Intelligence' instead of 'Super Intelligence' to be 'THE ENEMY'.
It came just over a week after an executive order telling federal agencies to call AI 'super intelligence'.
At the UN General Assembly Trump had said the word 'artificial' makes intelligence sound fake.
The Independent says he cannot force citizens or private firms to use the term; the White House named tech chiefs such as Elon Musk and Nvidia's Jensen Huang as users of it.
The Independent says the word superintelligence already means AI that surpasses humans across many domains.
Quinnipiac poll: 73 percent oppose an AI data centre in their community; Fox News poll: 37 percent favourable to 60 percent unfavourable on AI.
quote_evidence: Writing on Truth Social, he declared that the White House “considers anyone that uses the term, ‘Artificial Intelligence,’ as opposed to the highly accepted new and more accurate term, ‘Super Intelligence,’ THE ENEMY!”
He can direct the government to use it but he cannot force Americans — or anyone else — to use his preferred terminology.

Complicating the matter, the word superintelligence already means an AI system that surpasses human intellect and ability across multiple domains in couding reasoning, social skills and scientific research
why_it_matters_hint: A White House naming push that follows an executive order and coincides with falling public support for AI.
notes: Forbes original returned 403; read The Independent (own reporting). Politico, Axios, Business Insider and CNN also carry the story.
